## Read first
- The local Oracle forecast/MCP service stays read-only; a separately enabled TradingView worker can submit Coinbase spot orders or GUM ZEC perpetual Actions. Dry-run remains the default. [src: oracle/README.md#oracle-023; docs/JUPITER-ZEC-WEBHOOK.md]
- GUM application funding, perps collateral deposits and locally verified order Actions are separate boundaries. The order signer does not verify an opaque funding transaction. [src: docs/JUPITER-ZEC-WEBHOOK.md#capital-and-account-requirements; oracle/gum_orders.py]
- The owner selected ZEC/USDC with 2x leverage and 75 percent of available USDC as collateral; this policy does not establish a profitable strategy. [src: docs/JUPITER-ZEC-WEBHOOK.md#capital-and-account-requirements]

Source versions do not prove installation or deployment. - Website 0.4.0 adds dedicated native SOL/BTC/ETH/ZEC analysis, durable backtests, encrypted customer Coinbase execution, managed-bot consent and subscription lifecycle controls. Prices remain $9.99/3 slots/10 daily runs, $29.99/10 slots/unlimited runs and $49.99/unlimited counts; first-eligible trial7days. Production billing/trading stay closed pending provider acceptance. [src: website/README.md; website/src/worker.js; website/src/managed-bots.js]
- Hosted MCP 2025-11-25 JSON POST uses OAuth PKCE S256 and resource-bound bearer grants. Account status and intents always belong to that bearer wallet; cookies and caller-supplied wallet/account/signer overrides cannot replace it. [src: website/src/oauth.js; website/src/mcp.js; website/docs/MCP-DESIGN.md]
- Trading consent signs finite wallet-owned authority once. Legacy policies permit spot1x; v2 explicitly binds products/leverage plus venue/assets, fee-inclusive notional caps and expiry. Managed bots sign a distinct immutable config/strategy/connection binding. Settings revocation is immediate. [src: website/src/policy-scope.js; website/src/oauth.js; website/src/managed-bots.js]
- Private Coinbase execution enforces current wallet authority, exact preview/fees, cumulative budget, aggregate bot inventory, final plan capacity and stable-order reconciliation. Unknown orders retain commitments; deletion fences writers and verifies encrypted erasure. Workers Paid and Stripe sandbox acceptance remain provider gates; Jupiter filled-position/cumulative authority is unqualified. [src: website/execution/worker.js; website/src/trades.js; website/src/account-lifecycle.js; website/README.md#launch-gates-and-cloudflare-layout]

- Extension defaults stay dry-run and disarmed; its central risk rails fail closed. [src: CLAUDE.md#non-negotiables--extension]
- SolTUI has a separately armed manual Coinbase path; it is not merely a read-only display. [src: CLAUDE.md#what-this-is]
